description: Everything about one piece: what it is for, how long it may last, its settings and their choices, and for a shot its elements (texts, 3-D objects), every word it shows as an example (`words`, by the key set_text takes; `settings` says which words take *asterisks* and which settings only show once written) and its `anatomy`: where each element sits in each format, when and how it comes in, the camera's move, the sounds it brings. Read it before filling a shot.

example.description: Instead of id: how to write a piece of this kind (create_piece), with a model that passes

id.description: A piece id, e.g. shot/phone-hero, one of the user's own pieces, or the id of a piece people shared (search_community)

lang.description: Language of the names and of the example words (default en)

name: get_piece
title: Describe a piece
